pinchZoom.name: Pinch zoom

rover.title: Mars rover
rover.keys: W/S or arrows: drive · A/D: steer · mouse: camera · Esc: exit
rover.hand: Move an open palm from the centre to drive and steer. A fist stops.
rover.note: Colour and large-scale relief are real Jezero data with compressed distances. The rover, rocks and fine detail are illustrative.
facts: Basalt: a dark volcanic rock common on Mars.
Iron oxide: the main reason Mars looks red.
Carbonates: minerals that can form with the help of water.
Clay minerals: a sign that water once altered the rock.
Jezero crater: known for traces of an ancient lake and river delta.
